description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing user preferences in the Mattermost application, including fetching, saving, and deleting preferences and themes.

methods.name: deletePreferences
methods.description: Deletes specified preferences for a user, dispatching appropriate Redux actions and calling the Client4 API.

methods.name: getMyPreferences
methods.description: Fetches the current user's preferences using a bound client function.

methods.name: getUserPreferences
methods.description: Fetches preferences for a specified user other than the current user.

methods.name: setCustomStatusInitialisationState
methods.description: Sets the initial state for custom status preferences for the current user.

methods.name: savePreferences
methods.description: Saves preferences for a user, dispatching Redux actions and calling the Client4 API.

methods.name: saveTheme
methods.description: Saves a theme preference for a team and current user.

methods.name: deleteTeamSpecificThemes
methods.description: Deletes all theme preferences that are team-specific for the current user.
